title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey fined DataOne $1.07 million on Tuesday after state inspectors found 62 natural gas generators at its Vineland data center site in late July. The 2,000 kilowatt generators lacked required permits to be installed or operated. The fine was for violating the state's Air Pollution Control Act and was the largest ever issued to a New Jersey data center operator, officials said.

The planned data center is a 2.6 million square foot campus that will need 350 megawatts, enough to power a city of medium size, and is slated for completion at the end of the year. Some of it is already in use. Homeowners have filed a federal lawsuit over persistent noise, and the Cumberland County Health Department issued violation orders for excessive noise. Governor Mikie Sherrill said at a Climate Week event that data center growth must benefit New Jersey communities.
